decisions.description: Only the Contact's most recently created agreement may set the Contact's Agreement Status; status changes on older agreements are ignored.
decisions.name: Is_Latest_Agreement
decisions.label: Is Latest Agreement?

Flow.description: Keeps the recipient Sales Vendor contact's Agreement Status equal to the Adobe Sign status of the Contact's most recently created agreement - from the moment it is created (Draft, Pre-Send, Send in Progress, Created) through Out for Approval, Approved, Out for Signature, Signed, Cancelled / Declined, Expired. Status changes on older agreements for the same Contact are ignored. Waiting-for-counter statuses map to their parent status. Sales Vendor record type only.

formulas.description: Adobe Sign status mapped to the Contact Agreement Status picklist value (blank = no change).
formulas.name: frmContactStatus
formulas.expression: CASE(TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}), "Draft", "Draft", "Pre-Send", "Pre-Send", "Send in Progress", "Send in Progress", "Created", "Created", "Approved", "Approved", "Out for Approval", "Out for Approval", "Waiting for Counter-Approval", "Out for Approval", "Out for Signature", "Out for Signature", "Waiting for Counter-Signature", "Out for Signature", "Signed", "Signed", "Cancelled / Declined", "Cancelled / Declined", "Expired", "Expired", "")

Flow.label: Adobe Agreement - Update Contact Status

recordLookups.description: The recipient Contact's most recently created Adobe Sign agreement.
recordLookups.name: Get_Latest_Agreement
recordLookups.label: Get Latest Agreement

start.filterFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Recipient__c})), {!$Record.echosign_dev1__Recipient__r.RecordType.DeveloperName} = "Sales_Vendor", OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Draft"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Pre-Send"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Send in Progress"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Created"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Out for Approval"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Waiting for Counter-Approval"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Out for Signature"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Waiting for Counter-Signature"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Signed"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Cancelled / Declined"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}, "Expired") ))
